# Mermaid

Vendored browser distribution of Mermaid 11.16.0.

- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mermaid/v/11.16.0
- Package: `mermaid@11.16.0`
- Included: `dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs` and its minified `.mjs` chunks
- Excluded: source maps, TypeScript declarations, tests, and non-browser builds

To update it, download the new npm package and replace the entry module and the
complete `dist/chunks/mermaid.esm.min/` module set together.
